description: This file contains utility methods for GLSL to HLSL translation, including functions for texture and sampler string generation, variable decoration, and function name disambiguation.

methods.name: DisambiguateFunctionNameForParameterType
methods.description: Adds disambiguation suffixes to function names based on parameter types to avoid name conflicts in HLSL translation.

methods.name: SamplerString
methods.description: Returns the sampler string based on the basic type or texture group.

methods.name: TextureGroup
methods.description: Determines the texture group based on the basic type and internal format.

methods.name: TextureString
methods.description: Returns the texture type string for a given texture group.

methods.name: TextureGroupSuffix
methods.description: Provides suffix string for a texture group.

methods.name: TextureTypeSuffix
methods.description: Provides suffix string for a texture type based on its internal format.

methods.name: RWTextureGroup
methods.description: Determines the read-write texture group based on type and internal format.

methods.name: RWTextureString
methods.description: Returns the RWTexture type string for a given RWTexture group.

methods.name: RWTextureGroupSuffix
methods.description: Provides suffix string for an RWTexture group.

methods.name: RWTextureTypeSuffix
methods.description: Provides suffix string for an RWTexture type based on internal format.

methods.name: DecorateField
methods.description: Decorates a field name based on its structure context.

methods.name: DecoratePrivate
methods.description: Prefixes a variable name with 'dx_' for private variables.

methods.name: Decorate
methods.description: Adds an underscore prefix to names not starting with 'gl_'.

methods.name: DecorateVariableIfNeeded
methods.description: Decorates variable names, adding unique suffixes for user-defined temporaries.

methods.name: DecorateFunctionIfNeeded
methods.description: Prefixes internal functions with 'f_' to disambiguate from variables.

methods.name: TypeString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a type, including matrices and structs.

methods.name: StructNameString
methods.description: Returns the name string for a structure, considering global scope.

methods.name: QualifiedStructNameString
methods.description: Returns a qualified name for a structure, considering packing conventions.

methods.name: InterpolationString
methods.description: Returns the interpolation qualifier string.

methods.name: QualifierString
methods.description: Returns the qualifier string for a variable.

methods.name: DisambiguateFunctionName
methods.description: Generates a disambiguated function name based on parameter types or arguments.
